judge_scope: Development calibration on five previously reviewed groups, not 60 independent scenarios. Assistant labels are not independent expert gold.
how_to_report: Report all controls and coverage; do not report only the accuracy of valid outputs. Report original and supplemental retry results separately.
T07_rescore_rule: Baseline and punctuation candidate must use the same evaluator version and failure policy before weight/K selection. Do not compare the new single-case integration value to old full-run averages as a performance gain.
source_limitations: BFP fee exception ranking and documented source ambiguities remain; no corpus or dictionary edits performed here.
